events.context: Define KL Divergence metric as D_KL(P_model || P_uniform) = log(V) - H(P_model)
Define Minimum Description Length (MDL) as |compress(x)| / |x| using DEFLATE
Define Agency Index A = D_KL / MDL
Monte Carlo simulation with 250,000 trajectories producing idealized governance landscape
Property 1: Smooth monotonicity of Agency Index with bias β from A=0.048 at β=0 to A=3.96 at β=1.0
Property 2: Noise independence, agency curves overlap across η=0.00 to 0.75
Property 3: Minimal variance with σ=0.0003 to 0.05
Property 4: Structural homogeneity with MDL=1.0215 constant across parameters
Table 2 summarizes phase space quadrants with agency and variance values
List four governance assumptions validated by simulation: decomposability, alignment dominance, predictive stability, continuous response
Measure Agency Index on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Phi-3.5-mini across temperature τ ∈ [0.1, 2.0], 100 trials per point
Violation 1: Variance explosion with σ=17.7 at τ=0.9
Violation 2: Phase transition at τ≈0.9 with non-monotonic variance spike
Violation 3: Counter-intuitive scale effects, smaller Phi-3.5-mini (3.8B) more stable than larger Llama-3.1-8B (8B)
Violation 4: Noise dependence with Agency drop from A=53.6 at τ=0.2 to A=19.9 at τ=1.5
